intro: Fort Worth listings advertise non-climate 10x10 units from about $23. The city street rate is about $89/month, while the Dallas–Fort Worth metro average is about $103. Fort Worth prices under Dallas proper, but fees and the first existing-customer increase still put the six-month average above either advertised figure.
data_asof: Aug–Oct 2026 (StorageCafe, Storage Stats). StorageUnitCosts does not publish a Fort Worth city page; the metro figure is Dallas–Fort Worth.

units.notes: Locker / closet size. Fixed fees dominate the true cost at this size. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Non-climate listings from about $12; climate-controlled from about $10. Climate-controlled street rate ~$38.
Walk-in closet; studio overflow. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). No reliable lowest-promo figure published for this size (gap). Climate-controlled ~$58.

Most rented size. Fort Worth city average $89, down 4.3% YoY (StorageCafe, Sep 2026); the listing page's non-climate average is $88. Dallas–Fort Worth metro averages $103, down 8.7% YoY (Storage Stats) — that figure includes Dallas, not Fort Worth alone. StorageUnitCosts does not publish Fort Worth (Dallas, a different city, is $110). Climate-controlled city street rate ~$102. Non-climate listings from about $23.
Two-bedroom contents. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$134.
Three-bedroom home or a car. Estimate: single source (StorageCafe, Sep 2026). Climate-controlled ~$171. Non-climate listings from about $42.

local_tips: StorageCafe lists Southland Terrace (~$58), Sylvania Park (~$71) and Handley Heights South (~$73) among the cheapest areas, while Primrose Crossing (~$222) and Stonegate (~$220) run highest. Downtown Fort Worth averages about $156.
Fort Worth's all-unit average is lowest around November (~$125) and highest in August (~$128), StorageCafe. The seasonal gap is small.

Fort Worth the city has about 6.4 sq ft of storage per person and 122 facilities (StorageCafe). The Dallas–Fort Worth metro has 1,500+ facilities, more than any other U.S. metro (Storage Stats), and asking rents there are down 8.7% year over year — use a Dallas quote as leverage, then compare the month-4 rate.
On StorageCafe's Fort Worth cut, climate-controlled units can average less than standard units overall. Price both.
Extra Space's published admin fee is $50 on StorageUnitCosts city pages, higher than our $29 default; adjust the calculator if your facility charges more.
